4-3.headline: 1–9 Bruisers Bury 8D by 80
4-3.text: {S4} snapped seven straight losses with a season-high 136.0 and celebrated like it was a title. {S3} started four projected zeros, went 0–11 in all-play and lost by 80.5.

9-2.headline: Travis Flattens Doughboys by 49.92
9-2.text: {S9} dropped the week's high, 148.36, and went 11–0 in all-play. {S2} benched Brock Purdy's 22.2 for Trevor Lawrence's 12.74, posted a season-low 98.44 and fell from 7–3.

3.headline: 8D's Season Is Over at 3–8
3.text: Mathematically dead with three weeks left. {S3} has the league's fewest points, 854.9, averages 77.7 a week, and got knocked out by a team that was 1–9.

6.headline: IDK Eliminated With a Perfect Lineup
6.text: {S6} started the best possible lineup, 77.36, and still lost by 37.32. At 3–8 there's no path to the top 6. Five losses in the last six.

4.headline: Bruisers Were Already Done at 1–9
4.text: Knocked out after week 10, the league's first team eliminated. {S4} has 2 wins in 11 weeks and three games left to wreck somebody else's playoff push.
